composition.serve_who: This sheet (Termodinamica SW108-01) is the wiring schematic for the vessel's VRV18E1 direct-refrigerant aircon system: two VRV18E1 compressor units (Port engine room / Stbd engine room), each with its own sea water cooling pump, feeding a BUS-networked chain of fan coil (air handler) units and touch-screen interfaces throughout the accommodation. Every branch off the BUS Master Line names a specific cabin/fancoil (Fwd Guest, Salon port/stbd, Aft Guest port/stbd, Fwd/Aft Galley, Aft/Fwd Crew port/stbd, Owner's cabin) — each belongs to its own aircon-fancoil node per engineer-established aliasing; the two VRV18E1 units and their sea water pumps belong to the compressor-unit nodes; the touch screens, BUS bridges, current sensors and switch box are shared aircon-system infrastructure (590-aircon-system) not owned by any single fancoil.

facts: Internet Router distributes Ethernet LAN to two 'Touch Screen 7' nodes (Port and Stbd) via UTP CAT.5 cable.
Two Touch Screen Interface boxes (Addr.1, one per side) at 10W@24VDC bridge the touch screen 7 units to the BUS Master Line, and each side also has a 'TMD Internet Interface' at 80W@24VDC.

Each side's fancoil chain terminates in an AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS mod.QI-50-V-485 (Addr.31, 5W@24VDC, max 50A clamp) then a TMD Bridge (Addr.32, 5W@24VDC) then RS485 Modbus RTU output — shared monitoring/bridging infrastructure, not owned by any single fancoil.

A 'Switch BUS Box Connection' sits between the Port and Stbd VRV18E1 units, linking Port and Stbd BUS master lines together via the BUS Slave Line loop (pink/magenta) — ties the two otherwise-parallel BUS networks into one control network.

BUS cable specification: min 0.5mm²/max 1.0mm² conductor, 100-120 ohm impedance, 50-60pF/m capacitance, twisted pair ~10 twists/meter; shield/screen grounded only at compressor box side, never at the air handler electronic panel; must be routed min. 10cm from AC/DC power wiring, sheathed where possible.
Compressor ground/anode wire must connect ONLY to an independent anode/zinc — never to any other device — warranty is voided otherwise.
24VDC DC power supply cable for the Termodinamica bus must run as a single line sourced from the compressor unit or a single point; multiple power sources not allowed.
PCB entry into the Air Handler electronic panel must always use 2x2x0.75mm² wire.

Six detail insets (right side of sheet) show component-level rear-view wiring for: SyxthSense Touch Screen, VRV18E1 terminal block, Touch Screen & SubSlave Air Handler, Air Handler wiring (Master/Slave), Air Handler Port/Stbd connection, Master/Slave Air Handler linking, TS7E 7" Exor Touch Screen & Dual Touch Screen Interfaces, AC/DC Current Sensor detail, and Switch BUS Box internal wiring — these are wiring detail views of the same infrastructure/equipment already listed, not separate systems.

uncertainties: 'FANCOIL NOTES' box at top of sheet is present but appears to have no visible/legible content — cannot extract any notes from it.

Aft Galley fancoil (Addr.5.1, MRMAXI30i) shows no dedicated 'Therm' thermostat block drawn above it on the sheet, unlike its neighbors — control method for this unit could not be confirmed from the drawn lines; flagged rather than assumed identical to neighbors.

Exact wire gauge/length tier actually used for each BUS Master/Slave run (out of the 3 tiers listed in the cable spec table) is not distinguishable per-run from the drawing; only the general spec table is legible.
